snippet.title: Autonomica - Official Gameplay Trailer | The MIX Summer Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Here's a fresh look at Autonomica in this new trailer for the upcoming open-world game inspired by solarpunk aesthetics, driven by advanced automation and sustainable farming. The new Autonomica trailer shows building elements, gameplay, and its colorful world. Autonomica will be available on PC, PlayStation, and Xbox.
